value.rationale: A natural phase-randomized resource diagnostic has a strict graph-cycle hierarchy: the mean is fixed by dephased purity, the variance by fourth powers of coherence magnitudes, and the first phase-sensitive centered statistic by squared triangular products. Explicit full-rank families prove dimension three is the sharp onset and that two states indistinguishable by all entry magnitudes and first two resource moments can have opposite skewness. This motivates higher-moment measurement in experiments using phase-twirled ensembles rather than an arbitrary invariant.
